intro.text: A singer appointed citylady of Hearthstone by the Fused, once a parshwoman slave of Brightlord Wistiow.

items.text: Abiajan was enslaved to Brightlord Wistiow from a young age, under another name. As a child she hurt her arm, and Lirin set it.
When the Everstorm came she fled Hearthstone with the other singers. After some months the Fused sent her back as citylady, along with singers from the surrounding area.

Abiajan let Lirin check arriving Herdazian refugees for disease. When the Fused Lezian came hunting Kaladin, who was hidden among them, a fight broke out; afterwards, at Kaladin's suggestion, she persuaded the singers they had lost and led them to a stormshelter outside town.

appearance.text: White skin with red marbling on her cheeks. She wears an Alethi-style havah in muted colours that show off her skin patterns.

personality.text: Resentful of humans for enslaving her people, she speaks and acts like an Alethi yet tries to imitate the ancient singers the Fused describe. She has a sense of duty and leadership.
